name: jscpd-to-codecharta
description: Convert a jscpd JSON report to a mergeable CodeCharta 1.3 cc.json file. Verified against jscpd v5 (Rust) - v5 has no reporter plugin mechanism, so this consumes its json reporter output instead.

scripts.test: node test/convert.test.js && node test/fix-merged-edges.test.js && node test/strip-edges.test.js && node test/pipeline-sync.test.js
